name: Goblet squat
howTo: Hold a weight at your chest, sit down between your heels, stand tall.

name: Barbell back squat
howTo: Bar on upper back, brace, sit down and back, drive up through the whole foot.

name: Bodyweight squat
howTo: Feet shoulder-width, sit back like into a chair, stand up.

name: Romanian deadlift
howTo: Soft knees, push hips back with a flat back, feel the hamstrings, stand up.

name: Glute bridge
howTo: Lie on your back, feet flat, squeeze your glutes to lift hips, lower slowly.

name: Trap bar deadlift
howTo: Stand inside the bar, brace, push the floor away.

name: Reverse lunge
howTo: Step back, lower the back knee toward the floor, push through the front foot.

name: Step-up
howTo: Step onto a sturdy box or stair, stand tall, step down with control.

name: Push-up
howTo: Hands under shoulders, body in a line, lower your chest, push back up. Knees down is fine.

name: Dumbbell bench press
howTo: Lie on a bench, press dumbbells up over your chest, lower with control.

name: Barbell bench press
howTo: Eyes under the bar, lower to mid-chest, press up. Use a spotter.

name: Pike push-up
howTo: Hips high, bend elbows to bring your head toward the floor, press back.

name: Dumbbell shoulder press
howTo: Press dumbbells overhead without arching your back.

name: One-arm dumbbell row
howTo: Hand on a bench, pull the dumbbell to your hip, lower slowly.

name: Seated cable row
howTo: Sit tall, pull the handle to your belly, squeeze shoulder blades.

name: Table or towel row
howTo: Under a sturdy table, pull your chest up to the edge. Or pull a towel looped around a door handle.

name: Lat pulldown
howTo: Pull the bar to your upper chest, elbows down and back.

name: Band or doorway pull
howTo: Pull a band down from overhead, or do slow doorway pulls.

name: Plank
howTo: Forearms down, body straight, breathe. Hold 20 to 40 seconds.

name: Dead bug
howTo: On your back, lower opposite arm and leg slowly while keeping your back flat.

name: Farmer carry
howTo: Hold heavy weights at your sides and walk tall for 30 to 40 steps.

name: Bag carry
howTo: Carry a full bag or backpack in one hand, walk tall, switch hands.
